briefdescription.para: Similar to m_SpecificReg/Type, but the specific value to match originated from an earlier sub-pattern in the same mi_match expression.

detaileddescription.para: For example, we cannot match (add X, X) with m_GAdd(m_Reg(X), m_SpecificReg(X)) because X is not initialized at the time it's passed to m_SpecificReg. Instead, we can use m_GAdd(m_Reg(x), m_DeferredReg(X)).
